description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'SearchableBaseNoteFragment' for an Android application, providing search functionality within notes, including handling search queries, navigation between search results, and UI interactions such as floating action buttons and search view management.

classes.name: SearchableBaseNoteFragment
classes.description: An abstract fragment class providing search functionality within notes, including handling search queries, navigation between search results, and UI interactions such as floating action buttons and search view management.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the color property with a default brand color when the fragment starts.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Restores search query and current occurrence state from saved instance state.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events to toggle visibility of the direct editing FAB based on scroll position.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the UI components, including direct editing options and FABs, based on whether direct edit is enabled.

methods.name: checkDirectEditingAvailable
methods.description: Checks if remote direct editing is available for the current account.

methods.name: isDirectEditEnabled
methods.description: Determines if direct editing is enabled based on remote availability and user preferences.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Configures the search menu item, search view, and search result navigation, including handling search query input with delay.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current search query and occurrence state to the instance state bundle.

methods.name: colorWithText
methods.description: Abstract method to apply color styling to the search text and highlight current occurrence.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the layout used for text display.

methods.name: getSearchNextButton
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the 'next' search result button.

methods.name: getSearchPrevButton
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the 'previous' search result button.

methods.name: getDirectEditingButton
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the direct editing FAB.

methods.name: getNormalEditButton
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the normal edit FAB.

methods.name: jumpToOccurrence
methods.description: Navigates to the current search occurrence within the text layout.

methods.name: indexOfNth
methods.description: Utility method to find the nth occurrence of a substring within a string.

methods.name: countOccurrences
methods.description: Counts the number of occurrences of a substring within a string using regex.
